==About==

{{i|Milkweed Roots}} can be found commonly in the wild, when Rummaging an {{i|Abandoned Bird's Nest}}, or when Splitting a {{i|Rotten Log}} with {{i|Any Axe}} if you heard ''squishing'' when Shaking it. Additionally, with the [[Gardening]] Skill learned, grown by Planting another Milkweed Root in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Milkweed Roots count as {{i|Any Flower}} and therefore can be stored in a {{i|Flower Sack}}. Picking {{i|Any Flower}}s from the wild or Planting them in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. You may receive a {{i|Drone Bee}} or {{i|Queen Bee}} when Picking Milkweed Roots from the wild or spawn a {{i|Monarch Butterfly}}.
